optimizations_applied: Pairwise distance: 32x32 shared-memory tiled kernel (pairwise_distance_tiled_kernel) replacing the naive per-thread global-memory kernel. Justified by M4: 78.9-80.0% of kernel time at N=10K/25K.
k-NN: right-sized top-k register buffer (OPT_KNN_MAX_K=32 vs. naive KNN_MAX_K=256) plus float4-vectorized row scan. Justified by M4: 19.9-20.9% of kernel time at N=10K/25K.
optimizations_not_attempted: Reachability distance, LRD, LOF-scoring kernels left unmodified - M4 measured these as sub-millisecond and together under 0.2% of total kernel time at both 10K and 25K, so optimizing them would not move end-to-end performance measurably.
optimized_knn_constraint: Optimized k-NN/pipeline kernels support k <= 32 (project default k=20 is within range).
